title: Standing Desk Ratio Below Target
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=upliftdesk:desk standing_minutes=* sitting_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(standing_minutes) as standing_minutes, sum(sitting_minutes) as sitting_minutes by _time
| eval standing_pct=round(100*standing_minutes/(standing_minutes+sitting_minutes),1)
| where standing_pct<35
| sort - _time
description: Flags days where standing time falls below a chosen target share of the workday.
value: A percentage target is easier to live with than a vague aspiration to stand more often.
implementation: Send desk state changes to Splunk and roll them up into total standing versus sitting minutes each day.
visualization: Daily column chart of standing percentage with a target line.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which workdays stayed too seated and needed more stand-up time.
